children: Health Catalyst appointed Tami Reller to its board effective October 1, 2026, naming her Audit Committee chair and a member of the Compensation Committee.
Class III Director; Chair of the Audit Committee; Member of the Compensation Committee
Appointment to fill newly created board seat due to expansion from six to seven directors
Replaced Jill Hoggard Green on Audit and Compensation Committees; replaced Justin Spencer as Audit Committee chair (Spencer remains on Audit Committee)

Former President/CEO/Chair at Duly Health and Care; senior roles at UnitedHealth Group subsidiaries and Microsoft; board member of SPS Commerce; director at Fairview Health Services; B.S. Math (Univ. of Minnesota, Moorhead), MBA (St. Mary's College)
Appointed Audit Committee chair; appointed to Audit and Compensation Committees
